extracted.name: Banana Bread Baked Oats
extracted.description: I had some overripe bananas sitting in my pantry and didn’t have all the ingredients to make banana bread. So decided to combine some of the banana bread steps / ingredients with an oat mug muffin cake I bake and I can confidently say that this experiment worked!
ingredient_lines: 1 teaspoon) (If using all-purpose flour: baking powder
instruction_lines: Grease a loaf tin and set aside.
In a bowl, mix all ingredients until well combined.
Pour mixture into the greased loaf tin.
